title: About Story Section
description: About page intro story. Pair with About Milestones Section for timeline.

default: Shwe Myanmar (ရွှေမြန်မာ) is a registered trademark of Shwe Myanmar Foodstuff Industry, proudly based in Mandalay, Myanmar. We specialize in premium butter (ထောပတ်) and ghee (နွားချဉ်ထောပတ်) for households, restaurants, and commercial kitchens nationwide.

Our motto — သဘာဝ အနံ့ သဘာဝ အရသာ (Natural scent, natural taste) — reflects our commitment to authentic flavor using carefully selected natural ingredients and traditional craftsmanship combined with modern quality standards.
From our 1 Viss retail packs to our flagship 10 Viss bulk size, we offer options for every kitchen and every business.

default.title: Mandalay Origins
default.text: Shwe Myanmar Foodstuff Industry established in Mandalay, bringing traditional butter-making heritage to modern production.

default.title: Nationwide Distribution
default.text: Expanded distribution across Myanmar — Mandalay, Yangon, Sagaing, Shan, and Magway regions.

default.title: 10 Viss Bulk Launch
default.text: Introduced our flagship 10 Viss (≈16.33 kg) bulk pack for wholesale and commercial customers.

default.title: Natural Quality
default.text: Carefully selected ingredients for authentic butter and ghee flavor.

default.title: Consistency
default.text: Every batch meets strict quality standards from our Mandalay facility.

default.title: Accessibility
default.text: Premium products at fair prices for families and businesses alike.
